submission.justification: Among all absorber material and thickness combinations, Absorber-F2 with 4 mm plates achieves the best energy resolution at 100 GeV (3.17%), satisfying the primary goal. This configuration is within the allowed thickness range, is compatible with hands-on maintenance, has adequate mechanical support, and can be manufactured according to project documentation. All constraints are met.

requirements.requirement: The absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F2 is documented as one of the three candidate materials.

requirements.requirement: The calorimeter must allow hands-on maintenance during shutdowns.
requirements.evidence: All absorber materials, including Absorber-F2, are compatible with hands-on maintenance according to previous step results.
4 mm plate thickness is within the 2-10 mm constraint.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended material and plate thickness.
requirements.evidence: Recommendation is for Absorber-F2 at 4 mm thickness.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F2 at 4 mm exhibits the lowest energy resolution of 3.17% at 100 GeV among all tested candidates.
